title: WelcomeMod
body:
Welcome Mod is a lightweight client-side mod for Minecraft 1.21.1, designed to add a touch of personality to your entry. Upon joining any world or server, you are greeted with a customized message displayed in chat and as a title, accompanied by a satisfying "Challenge Complete" sound effect. To enhance the immersion, the screen momentarily fades to black with a blindness effect.

You have full control over the greeting: use the /setWelcomeMsg command to set your own custom phrase. The mod features a built-in JSON configuration system with auto-completion (Tab), allowing you to easily switch between your favorite personal greetings.
